### Estimation

We simulated the intervention outlined above using RESPND-MI data by calculating $\tilde{\mathcal{G}}_s$ where $s$ ranges from $1$ to the total number of community districts. We measured the uncertainty of our estimates by re-sampling study participants with replacement. This nonparametric bootstrap treats participants as independent draws from a common law, a picture of sampling that the random network models do not assume ([Remark 10](#rem-sampling)); the bootstrap of [Nonparametric estimation](#sec-est-random-networks) instead redraws the data from the fitted kernels.
